title: 工具：Figma、表格与数据
html:
工具：Figma、表格与数据

概述

本章聚焦设计与协作工具的英语词汇，分为 Figma 协作、表格与电子表格、数据展示、文档协作四个部分。它帮助读者用英语描述设计协作和数据处理中的工具操作，重点在工具功能和协作动作的表达。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，适合跨角色沟通。建议把工具类词汇与其操作动作结合学习，便于在协作中准确说明需求。

Figma 协作

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
canvas n. 画布 design canvas, infinite canvas
frame n. 框架 create a frame, frame properties
layer n. 图层 layer structure, layer naming
inspect v. 检查 inspect mode, inspect properties
comment n./v. 评论 leave a comment, resolve comments
share v. 分享 share a link, share with editors

听说例句

A: Can you share the Figma file with the engineering team? B: Done. They can use inspect mode to check spacing, colors, and font sizes directly.

A: I left some comments on the canvas. B: I saw them. Let me address the feedback on the frame structure and resolve the comments.

写作表达

  • The Figma inspect mode enables developers to extract accurate design specifications without manual measurement.
  • Organizing layers with a clear naming convention improves collaboration and reduces miscommunication during handoff.

表格与电子表格

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
spreadsheet n. 电子表格 create a spreadsheet, shared spreadsheet
cell n. 单元格 cell value, merge cells
formula n. 公式 write a formula, complex formula
pivot table n. 数据透视表 create pivot table, pivot table analysis
column n. 列 add a column, column header
row n. 行 insert a row, row count

听说例句

A: Can you build a pivot table for the sales data? B: Sure. I'll organize it by region in columns and product category in rows.

A: The formula in cell D5 seems wrong. B: Let me check. I think the VLOOKUP reference is broken after we added new columns.

写作表达

  • The shared spreadsheet serves as the single source of truth for tracking project milestones across all teams.
  • Pivot table analysis enabled the team to quickly identify the top-performing product categories by region.

数据展示

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
chart n. 图表 bar chart, line chart
graph n. 图形 data graph, network graph
legend n. 图例 chart legend, add a legend
axis n. 轴 x-axis, y-axis
label n. 标签 data label, axis label
tooltip n. 提示框 hover tooltip, custom tooltip

听说例句

A: Should we use a bar chart or a line chart for the monthly trends? B: A line chart for trends over time. Add data labels and a legend so it's self-explanatory.

A: The graph is hard to read without axis labels. B: I'll add proper labels to both axes and include tooltips for the data points.

写作表达

  • The dashboard features interactive charts with custom tooltips, enabling users to explore data at a granular level.
  • Clear axis labels and a descriptive legend are essential for ensuring that visualizations are immediately interpretable.

文档协作

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
template n. 模板 document template, use a template
version history n. 版本历史 check version history, restore version
permission n. 权限 edit permission, view-only permission
embed v. 嵌入 embed a chart, embed a link
export v. 导出 export to PDF, export data
integration n. 集成 tool integration, third-party integration

听说例句

A: Can I embed this Figma frame into the PRD document? B: Yes, just copy the embed link. Make sure the permission is set to view-only for external stakeholders.

A: I need the version history for this document. B: Check the document settings. You can restore any previous version or export a specific one to PDF.

写作表达

  • Embedding live Figma frames into product documents ensures that specifications are always up to date.
  • Granular permission controls and version history provide a secure and auditable collaboration environment.
